notes.recoil: The legacy spread bloom (bloom per shot, cap, recovery per tick). With a family its spread comes from the family's accuracy; `maxBloom` still sets how long bots fire their bursts.
notes.group: The extended arsenal: every one fires differently. 7: automatics.
notes.design: Huge belt, poor handling: slow to draw and a long, dangerous reload.
notes.model: The owner's Rotary Gatling Gun (Meshy, owned; content/guns.json), the gun-pack machine gun as the fallback. (Before it: a Meshy community rotary-barrel gun, CC0 per the owner: no stock, so the rear handle sat at the shoulder.)
notes.viewOffset: Chunky (a tall body and a carry loop): further out and lower than a rifle, so it doesn't fill the view.
notes.hold: The stock is tall: its top sits in the shoulder, so the gun rides below the face.
